evidence.title: Equinix 2025 Annual Report (Form 10-K)
evidence.excerpt: Equinix's SEC complete submission contains its Form 10-K construction table listing eight specified Americas phase projects or redevelopment projects as under construction as of December 31, 2025.

metadata.capex_guardrail: Approximate total capex is a forward-looking dollar estimate that may change with final construction details. It is not power, energy, capacity, consumption, physical progress, or evidence of completion and creates no normalized capacity row.

metadata.location_guardrail: The reported locations are retained only as authoritative metro localities. The filing does not establish street addresses, parcels, points, footprints, geometries, co-location among similarly named metro facilities, or unique-site counts.
metadata.role_guardrail: The filer, executives, customers, suppliers, partners, landlords, and investors are not normalized into owner, operator, developer, tenant, customer, user, contractor, investor, utility, or other roles.
